description: Check whether a phone or tablet supports eSIM against the compatible-device list simoptions.com publishes, by its model name ("iPhone 15 Pro", "Samsung Galaxy S24") or model code ("SM-S921B"). "yes" names the listed model. "unknown" means it is not on the list, which only holds compatible models: it is not a no, and the phone's settings tell whether it has an eSIM option.

model.description: The phone or tablet: its model name ("iPhone 15 Pro", "Samsung Galaxy S24") or model code ("SM-S921B").

name: devices_check
title: Check eSIM compatibility
